visualBrief: Mountain-view-first Rainier photography, rebuilt for the 2026 wildfire closures. Sunrise, Mount Fremont and Burroughs are closed and are no longer featured subjects. The signature frames are now Reflection Lakes and Faraway Rock on Friday arrival, Skyline glacier scale and meadow curves on Saturday, Comet Falls and Van Trump Park on Sunday, then Tipsoo, the Seattle skyline and market energy at the finish. Reflection Lakes is now a featured subject; the earlier brief excluded it.
